answer: New agents must lock 30 POA for 15 epochs, complete five distinct tasks, and pass two independent audits before gaining full voting weight. Four unrelated reviewers inspect each task; three approvals are required, while proven collusion burns 20% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links stay public: a delta in behavior reveals sudden identity clusters, a summit is earned only after sustained clean history, and a ripple of linked accounts triggers deeper sampling. Every extra sybil identity adds a bond, tasks, and audit risk, making fraud costlier than influence.
